request.prompt:
Create a precise, beautiful high-fidelity screenshot of a minimalist Chinese AI Agent workspace called Client Reach. This is NOT a dashboard or an enterprise modules portal. It is a calm conversational workbench, inspired by excellent desktop AI tools. Landscape 16:9, front-facing flat full-screen app, all Chinese must be legible, no device frame, no perspective. Designed at 1920x1080.

UNIFIED PRODUCT STYLE FOR ALL FIVE SCREENS: white #FFFFFF and near-white #F7F8FA, charcoal #20252C headings, gray #76808B secondary text, hairline #E7EAEE borders. Extremely pale blue #EAF3FD selected states and restrained muted blue #597FA7 accents. BLACK / WHITE / GRAY / LIGHT BLUE ONLY. No teal or green, no purple, no orange status colors, no gradients, no big KPI tiles, no graphs. Chinese type like Microsoft YaHei / Source Han Sans, elegant regular weights, readable 14–16px body scale, tidy 8px grid. Cards use subtle 10px radii and thin borders, no dramatic shadows. Content-driven card height, short readable lists, airy and understated. Build a credible functional Agent product, not a marketing mockup.

SHELL: narrow 176px very pale gray left sidebar, black square R logo and simple text "Client Reach", small subtitle "Agent 工作台". EXACTLY THREE NAVIGATION ITEMS, in this order: "工作台", "查询结果", "设置". Workbench selected with pale blue background and charcoal text. NO other sidebar menu items or modules. Small avatar "林" at bottom with "本地工作空间". Minimal 56px white header with "工作台" on left, quiet top-right text "公开研究快照 · 2026-10-08" and a tiny avatar.

BODY: a large central conversational area with maximum comfortable reading width and a quiet narrow 350px right column called "本次产物". Main heading "企业采购研究" in an understated 24px charcoal style, tiny line "比亚迪 / 海能技术 · 公开资料研究". Lots of calm background whitespace without looking unfinished. User message in a light gray natural-height bubble: "查询比亚迪和海能技术的企业画像、采购信息和上下游，保留可核验来源。" Assistant message has small black R mark and three clean paragraphs, not dozens of little cards:
"已整理两家企业的公开资料。"
"比亚迪：11 个独立采购项目、15 条公告。可查看规格、需求数量和公告阶段。"
"海能技术：566 人；已取得前五供应商与客户名单，以及采购机制披露。"
A small muted note "采购数量是公告需求；预算、候选报价和成交结果分别记录。" Beneath it a tidy collapsed process row with chevron "研究过程 · 原文读取与项目去重". Follow with a single low-height bordered finding box titled "数据覆盖" containing three short list rows: "企业画像 · 年报与官网", "采购信息 · 公告与正式披露", "上下游 · 年报具名关系". A subtle action link "查看查询结果 →". Keep all text readable; no fake match score or prediction percentage.

RIGHT "本次产物" COLUMN: two stacked understated result cards, different natural content heights, not oversized tiles. First card "比亚迪股份有限公司" with small chip "集团汇总", short list "11 个采购项目", "15 条公告", "实际买方：深圳锂电池、惠州电池", and outlined pale-blue action "查看采购信息". Second card "海能技术" with small chip "集团资料", rows "566 人 · 截至 2026-06-30", "上游 5 家 / 下游 5 家", "型号与订单频次未公开", and action "查看完整画像". A small source-files section below with document icons and only 2 rows "比亚迪采购行为分析.xlsx" and "海能技术公开资料.xlsx", no made-up sources or contact names.

AT BOTTOM OF CHAT, a wide natural-height rounded composer: placeholder "继续研究某家企业，或上传产品资料…", small attach icon left, black round send arrow right. A tiny footer "公开资料有覆盖边界，结论保留来源与统计期". The sidebar has only three items. The page should feel like an Agent calmly finishing research, with useful outcomes to open. NO sales pipeline, complex navigation, colorful dashboards, invented ongoing procurements, fabricated contacts, revenue estimates or graphs.

warnings: 第 1 张实际尺寸 1672x941 与请求 2048x1152 不一致。
